meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: Claude 仍是调度者,但能调用本机 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里的模型:先列出可用模型,再把提示发给指定模型并取回回答。
howto.when: 当你要求用本地 Atomic Chat 模型回答问题,或提到 atomic chat、atomic_chat_generate 等工具名时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude stays the orchestrator but can call models running in the local Atomic Chat desktop app: it lists available models, then sends a prompt to a chosen model and returns the reply.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to answer with a local Atomic Chat model, or mention atomic chat or atomic_chat_generate.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
List the models available in atomic chat
Use an atomic chat model to write a Python bubble sort
say_en.note: Model must be downloaded in the app first
